summary: The place_room action calls Client.placeRoom with a room design id, a row and a column. It is not idempotent. Its params must be a numeric design id and non-negative integers, and the rooms must be observed first.  Reconciliation uses the ship's rooms alone: - verified: a room of that design is at that position afterwards and was not   there before, in any status (a new room is Building); - contradicted: a room present before has gone; - unknown: the rooms were not observed (and the runner already turns an   ambiguous response with no room into unknown); - not-observed: otherwise. A room changing design between the reads is not contradicted, because a finishing upgrade does that too. Reasons never name a room instance id.  An uncertain place_room now blocks every later placement on the account, at any position (S13-R6). Other actions keep their per-params block.

contract_status_changes.after: place_room reconciled from rooms; account-wide uncertainty block
proof: tests: spec shape; bad params refused; verified/not-observed/contradicted/unknown cases incl. a finished upgrade and a pre-existing room; no room ids in reasons or the journal; an ambiguous placement blocks placements at any position; a definite success without a room does not block; upgrade_room keeps per-params blocking
make syntax-check, make test (1345 OK), make lint, git diff --check pass
